lines: Five reasons the fake bag beats the real one. Stay for number one.
Number five: the price. Three thousand dollars, or about a hundred. Same look, thirty times cheaper.
Number four: you'll actually use it. No babying it, no dust bag, no panic when it rains.
Number three: nobody can tell. From across the room, a good replica looks just like the real thing.
Number two: trends move fast. When the hype dies, you've lost a hundred dollars, not three thousand.
And number one: the money you keep. Invest the difference, and in ten years it could grow to over five thousand dollars.
So, real or fake? Tell me in the comments.
